description: A temporary error such as a timeout, where trying again later will probably succeed.
An error such as an invalid payload that no retry can fix.
A retry policy that increases the wait after each attempt to give a dependency time to recover.
A topic that receives records which failed after the allowed retries so they can be inspected and replayed.
A record that can never be processed and, if unhandled, blocks the consumer.
A table of handled event ids used to skip repeats and make the consumer idempotent.
